about.title: What is Protothon?
about.description: Protothon is a prototyping hackathon that brings together innovators, designers, and programmers to create prototypes of real-world projects across four diverse tracks. Whether you're interested in health, security, redesigning things, or transportation, this is where your next product prototype begins.  This is where the journey starts. This is where your idea takes its first step toward becoming a reality.

tracks.title: Innovation Track
tracks.description: Unleash your imagination to redesign the things around you, and create modern products that combine simplicity and intelligence.

tracks.title: Health Track
tracks.description: Develop solutions that improve human health… from supporting patients and people with disabilities to smart clothing that changes their lives for the better

tracks.title: safety & Safety Track
tracks.description: Develop technologies that protect people and make them feel safe on roads, in homes, and even in factories.

tracks.title: Transportation & Vehicles Track
tracks.description: Creating solutions that facilitate movement, reduce congestion, and enhance the driving experience through smarter and more efficient technologies.

timeline.title: Registration Start
timeline.description: Participants begin forming their teams and choosing the track that suits them best

timeline.title: First Qualifiers
timeline.description: Intensive training in design, electronics, and programming to build a strong foundation before the competition

timeline.title: Initial Acceptance
timeline.description: Submitting the initial pitch, core components, and early prototype

timeline.title: Workshops (Online)
timeline.description: Selecting the best projects to advance to the in-person hackathon

timeline.title: Final Acceptance
timeline.description: Intensive working days to build the prototype with support from specialized mentors

timeline.title: Hackathon Days (In-Person)
timeline.description: Presenting the project before an expert panel to evaluate the idea, prototype, and impact

rules.title: rules
rules_list: The registration form must be fully completed before evaluation begins.
The idea must be related to one of the official Protothon challenges and tracks.
The work must be original and developed only during the hackathon period.
A functional prototype must be submitted to prove the idea’s feasibility.
A technical description, presentation, and disclosure of any pre-existing materials must be attached.
Teams cannot be mixed from both male and female campuses; all members must be either from the male campus or the female campus.

health.title: Health Track
health.subtitle: Developing assistive devices, medical apparel, physiotherapy solutions, or technologies that facilitate user interaction with their healthcare environment
health.overview: This track is for those who believe that technology can improve human health and raise quality of life. It focuses on developing smart solutions that take into account the needs of patients and people with disabilities, support treatment and rehabilitation, and provide practical tools that contribute to a more independent and comfortable life.

goals.goal: Supporting the independence of people with physical or cognitive disabilities.
Developing tools that support movement, focus, learning, and interaction in public spaces.
Innovating in physical therapy and motor rehabilitation.
Designing smart medical wearables to track exercises and home treatment.

challenges: Innovating healthcare solutions that support patients and people with disabilities while improving quality of care.
Developing technologies that enhance safety and security and prevent accidents in daily life and factories.
Redesigning tools and devices in innovative ways or converting inanimate objects into smart devices.
Creating transportation solutions that reduce congestion and improve driving experience and traffic systems.

safety.title: safety Track
safety.subtitle: This track offers the opportunity to develop intelligent systems that monitor, warn of, and provide effective protection in everyday or professional situations.
safety.overview: This track aims to create solutions that enhance safety in daily life and work environments. It enables participants to design technologies that prevent accidents before they occur, protect individuals, and proactively address factory hazards.

goals.goal: Developing smart technological solutions to enhance personal safety and workplace safety.
Preventing risks and enabling quick and effective response to accidents.
Innovating tools that provide daily safety from crimes, theft, harassment, and accidents.
Monitoring workplace hazards, predicting failures, and handling emergencies early.

challenges: Developing solutions that prevent daily accidents before they occur.
Designing technologies to protect children and the elderly.
Creating systems that monitor risks in factories.
Building tools that predict failures and provide rapid emergency response.

innovation.title: Innovation Track
innovation.subtitle: It allows participants to build prototypes of redesigned products or transform inanimate objects into smart devices by adding movement, sensing, or interaction.
innovation.overview: This track is geared towards unconventional ideas that reimagine the things around us. It combines creativity and engineering, encouraging the development of entirely new solutions or the redesign of existing tools in modern ways.

goals.goal: Reimagine existing objects with creative designs that enhance their functions or expand their uses.
Apply modern techniques to rebuild old or abandoned tools and devices with added features.
Transform static everyday items into smart, interactive, and practical devices.
Integrate movement, sensing, or user interaction into ordinary non-digital objects.

challenges: Disassemble old tools and redesign them in a modern way (reverse engineering).
Convert a static object into a smart device capable of movement or sensing.
Update home or office products by adding new functionalities.
Create an entirely new product inspired by a daily need.
